dedupe_keys.name: generative international hydrogen pipeline routes and costs considering geographical and political characteristics globally

description: Bastian Weißenburger at Fraunhofer ISI publishes approximately 4,900 calculated international hydrogen-pipeline routes and their costs. The August 2026 release accompanies a Nature Energy study of geographical and political influences on pipeline cost. A route table contains financing, land-use and levelised-cost parameters; a second CSV defines variables, and shapefiles provide a linestring keyed by RouteID for each route. Zenodo offers the archive free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is global and modelled, not an observed network or a list of committed construction projects. Routes and costs can provide candidate connections for hydrogen-trade and expansion-planning simulations. Their suitability depends on the study's routing, financing and political assumptions, which were not reproduced. No related catalogue parent explicitly includes this scenario collection. The archive, route geometries and costs were not downloaded or checked.
